kind.description:
Type of Receipt:
* `0` Direct to beneficiary/By hand
* `1` Boleto (Confirmed by bank via return file or API)
* `2` Pix (Confirmed by bank via Pix)

updated_at.description: Date and time of last update.

financial_provider_external_id.description: ID of receipt in the financial institution

line_parsed.description:
Parsed line with information coming from the bank:

Bank return content. It may change according to the bank and format 240 or 400. If any of the fields are blank, it is because your bank does not provide that information.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| paid_at | Receipt date |
| paid_amount | Paid amount |
| bank_rate | Boleto fee paid to the bank |
| credit_at | Credit date |
| credit_amount | Credit amount |
| our_number | Our number |
| processed_our_number_raw | Formatted our number |
| discount | Discount |
| billet_fine | Increases (Fine/Interest charged) |
| other_fines | Other additional charges |
| other_credit | Other paid values |
| value_rebate | Other fees |
| error_code | Error code |
| event_type | Bank occurrence |
| agency_number | Agency |
| account_number | Account |
| banco_recebedor | Receiving bank |
| agencia_recebedora | Receiving agency |
| control_number | Control number |
| document_number | Document number |
